name: Power station
desc: Huge, humming and fenced off - infrastructure as a landmark, or as a place to break into.
tags: power station, cooling towers, tall chimney, steam plume, steel pipework, high voltage pylons, transformer yard, chain link perimeter fence, sodium lamps, concrete blockwork, warning signs
prose: a power station standing beyond its perimeter fence, cooling towers and a tall chimney trailing steam, transformer yards and pylons marching away under sodium lights
note: Splits hard into two places that share a name: the exterior silhouette seen from outside the fence (cooling towers, chimney, pylons) and the turbine hall inside (green machine casings, overhead travelling crane, control room desks). Name which one, because asking for both gives neither. Steam from the towers is the single tag that decides running versus derelict, and derelict is where this drifts by default.
